senses.definition: (operations) The process of planning, implementing, and controlling the efficient, effective flow and storage of goods, services and related information from their point of origin to point of consumption for the purpose of satisfying customer requirements.
examples: The logistics of the operation required careful planning.
She works in logistics, managing global supply chains.
We underestimated the logistics of moving an entire lab.

senses.definition: (military) The procurement, supply, maintenance, and transportation of equipment, facilities, and personnel.
